segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the pads as hydrating and nourishing without leaving skin feeling dry, with one calling the formula perfect for dry, dehydrated skin and another saying it helped brighten and improve texture on dry skin.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports the pads are soothing and hydrating with no irritation noted.
segments.mature: One reviewer describes the milky formula as well suited to aging skin, finding it nourishing and refreshing.

concerns.aging: One reviewer with aging skin found the toner nourishing, refreshing and smoothing.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers single out dehydrated skin or dehydrated cheeks and report the pads leave skin hydrated, plump and smooth after use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer expects the rice extract to help reduce dark spots and hyperpigmentation with continued use, but describes this as an anticipated rather than confirmed effect.

extraits.texte: So going into this, I had never tried the original rice toner from I'm from, so this is my first impression. The toner pads are very saturated and hold a lot of the toner and they also adhere wonderfully and stretch well on my skin. The toner has a milky formula and it's perfect for dry, dehydrated and aging skin. It's extremely nourishing and refreshing and my skin felt so smooth after using it. My only fear is that I'll go through them too fast because they feel great, especially with the hot weather we are having now. Definitely recommend these for plump and moist skin.

extraits.texte: I am such a huge fan of I'm From's viral toner that I was excited to try their Rice Toner Pads. They are soaked in just the right amount of toner, are adjustable in size and very stretchy. Not only hydrating, they soothe my sensitive skin. They leave a nice glow after each use too! Loving the ingredients of these toner pads. Hydrating glycerin and olive fruit oil + niacinamide and the infamous Yeoju rice extracts offer a beautiful glow🌟 I would definitely recommend these toner pads 💛

extraits.texte: I'm From's Rice Toner is one of my all time favorite products that I've used daily for years so I was SO excited to see it in this toner pad form! The pads are generously soaked in toner. The material has a stretchy feel which allows it to conform to the face nicely. Also adheres well for masking. I love that you can leave the pad on, or just swipe as a toner. The formula is both hydrating and nourishing which makes it perfect for my dry skin. This toner has helped brighten my skin and improve texture. It's a truly a must have and so excited to have it in pad form now! Highly recommend!!

extraits.titre: This milky toner contains hydrating and moisturizing glyceri
extraits.texte: I'm From's cult-favorite Rice Toner is now available in pad form! This milky toner contains hydrating and moisturizing glycerin, olive oil, and betaine, as well as brightening rice and niacinamide. There are 60 pads per container, and all of them come well soaked in product. I don't detect any sort of fragrance. In addition to using these as traditional toner pads that you wipe over your face, their material is super stretchy, so you can use them as a targeted mini sheet masks. My skin is particularly dehydrated on my cheeks, so I like using them there for an extra boost.

extraits.texte: ANOTHER WIN FOR TEAM I'M FROM! As a long-time and faithful fan of the brand's rice line, I am super excited abo the launch of this new product . Now, they've introduced the Tiktok viral O.G Rice Toner effect in Toner Pads, and I couldn't be happier! These pads are incredibly convenient for a quick cleanse as soon as I wake up, without leaving my skin feeling dry. They provide an instant brightening effect, and my skin feels soft and luscious after use. The premium Yeoju rice extract naturally brightens and evens out my skin tone, and I'm pretty sure that with consistent & continuous use it'll definitely help in reducing my dark spots and hyperpigmentation for a much radiant complexion. I also love the very elastic material of the pad. It adjusts perfectly to different areas of my face, ensuring a seamless and effective application for my skincare routine. Whether I'm using it as a toner pack for deep nourishment or as a wipe-off toner to smooth and refine my skin texture, these pads deliver every time. For anyone looking for an easy, reliable way to maintain smooth and glowing skin, these Rice Toner Pads are a game-changer! Kudos again to Team I'm From! —and ofc TYSM to Team Wishtrend too!✨ xoxo abbhey :)

extraits.texte: A great product- a step up from the rice toner that lets your skin absorb even more moisture in. My skin was visibly softened after letting the pads on for 20min after 1st use so it will be amazing to use for whenever I'm in need of a super throughout hydration base for the rest of my skincare routine!

reserve: All 19 reviews are 5-star, so no critical or negative review is available to include, and reports on concerns like redness, barrier, blemishes and oiliness are absent from this set.
